title: 第009章 臭名昭著的军火贩子第010章 第二次虚空试炼 深渊劣魔
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: “异界旅人，这家伙，臭名昭著的军火贩子。”某个领地之中，一位俊朗的男人看着聊天频道的消息想到。
男人名叫叶修，上一世获得了唯一级天赋：重生，只能够重生一次的天赋，出现之后就不会在出现的天赋，没错他重生回来了。
“上辈子这家伙也是在新手期第一天就开始收购黑暗之种了，看样子一切都没变。”叶修眸子带着深邃，嘴角露出邪魅的笑容看着聊天频道的消息。
“如果没记错的话，这家伙在新手期二十天的时候才开始贩卖科技侧的军火，还闹起了很大的动静，他的兵种是科技侧的兵种，日后混的风生水起，还是这一代的新手期第一人。”叶修挂着笑容。
“科技侧的兵营前期发展的确快，但是后劲不足，这一世我有十阶兵种：屠龙勇士，再加上王者级天赋：王权，这新手期第一人也不是不能争。”
“先知先觉，这还能输，我真不信。”叶修带着自信。
“这家伙在新手期好像还获得了一个上位真神的传承，这辈子我要了，或许可以收为自己的附属领主，这样自己就不缺资源了。”
叶修开始了自己的谋划，作为重生者，他有这个自信，毕竟他重生的时候已经是成为领主十年的时候了。
小的事情或许记不住，但是大的事情，一些特殊的事情还是能记住的。
“啊切！！”苏业的领地之中，苏业打了一个喷嚏。
“谁在骂我？”苏业揉了揉鼻子。
“神皇大人，不会是冷感冒了吧？要不妾身来温暖一下神皇大人。”莉莉丝如同c女一样直接靠了过来。
柔软的身子压在了苏业的身上，体香钻入了苏业的鼻腔之中。
苏业撇了撇嘴看了一眼莉莉丝，臭女人，就知道馋自己的身子，值得一说的是因为水晶宫的加持，莉莉丝的潜力从根源晋升到了创世，其她的原罪堕天使潜力也从上位天神晋升到了主神的层次。
“不用了，先烤肉，我有些饿了。”苏业向着莉莉丝说道。
“知道了，神皇大人。”莉莉丝带着一丝幽怨的看了一眼苏业，开始了烤肉。
苏业则是躺在灵源湖边的草地上，享受着阳光和眼前的美景，二十位女神级尤物赤果果的在自己面前，要是不心动那是假的。
“等能回去的时候，一定找些跳舞的视频，让她们学一学。”苏业看着面前的原罪堕天使，脸上露出笑容。
随着时间的流逝。
夜幕降临。
对于其他领主来说是忙碌的一天，但是对于苏业来说则是无聊的一天，主要是没什么事情做。
私聊他的倒是有不少，不过都是一些直播链接。
特么的果然h色是第一生产力，哪里都有片哥片姐，苏业抱着批判的心思去看了看，不过纯白嫖没花钱。
主要是开开眼界，毕竟有些东西苏业真没见过，什么牛头人配萝莉，什么巨魔，触手怪，肉铠之类的。
苏业算是大开眼界了，之前知道领主玩的花，但是没想到玩的这么花。
堕天圣堂，苏业准备今天晚上就在这里对付一晚上，至于领主府，算了那破旧的木屋，还不如睡外面的草地上呢。
就在苏业准备考虑休息的时候，一道香风袭来，苏业感觉自己进入了一个温柔的怀抱。
“神皇大人，夜深了该休息了，妾身的奖励也是时候了吧。”莉莉丝柔媚入骨的声音响起。
苏业看向莉莉丝那蕴含春水的眼神，娇柔妩媚，仿佛能融化一切
一晚上的时间，苏业都在做梦。
content_en:
"Traveler from another world, this guy is a notorious arms dealer." In a certain territory, a handsome man thought while looking at the messages in the chat channel.
The man's name is Ye Xiu. In his last life, he received the only super talent: rebirth. A talent that can only be reborn once. A talent that will not appear again after it appears. Yes, he was reborn.
"In my previous life, this guy also started acquiring Dark Seeds on the first day of the novice period. It seems that nothing has changed." Ye Xiu looked at the messages in the chat channel with deep eyes and a devilish smile on his lips.
"If I remember correctly, this guy started selling technology arms only twenty days into the novice phase, and he made a big fuss. His army was a technology arm. He became very prosperous in the future, and he was still the number one in the novice phase of this generation." Ye Xiu smiled.
"The technology side of the barracks is indeed developing quickly in the early stage, but it lacks stamina. In this life, I have a tenth-level unit: Dragon Slaying Warrior, plus a king-level talent: King Power. I am not incapable of competing for the number one position in the novice stage."
"I have foresight. I really don't believe that we can still lose." Ye Xiu said with confidence.
"This guy seems to have obtained the inheritance of a high-level true god in his novice stage. I want it in this life. Maybe I can take it as my subordinate lord, so that I will not be short of resources."
Ye Xiu started his own plan. As a reborn person, he had this confidence. After all, he had already been a lord for ten years when he was reborn.
You may not be able to remember small things, but you can still remember big things and some special things.
.............................
"Ah!" Su ye sneezed in Su ye's territory.
"Who is scolding me?" Su ye rubbed his nose.
"Lord God Emperor, you don't have a cold, right? Why don't I come here to warm up Lord God Emperor." Lilith leaned over directly like a c-girl.
The soft body pressed against Su ye's body, and the body fragrance penetrated into Su ye's nose.
Su Ye curled his lips and glanced at Lilith, a stinky woman who knows how to covet her own body. It is worth mentioning that because of the blessing of the Crystal Palace, Lilith's potential has been promoted from the source to the creation of the world, and her original sin fallen angel potential has also been promoted from the upper god to the level of the main god.
"No, let's grill the meat first. I'm a little hungry." Su ye said to Lilith.
"I understand, Lord God Emperor." Lilith glanced at Su Ye with a hint of resentment and started to barbecue.
Su Ye was lying on the grass beside Lingyuan Lake, enjoying the sunshine and the beautiful scenery in front of him. Twenty goddess-level beauties were naked in front of him. It would be a lie if he was not moved.
"When I can go back, I must find some dancing videos and let them learn from it." Su ye looked at the original sin fallen angel in front of him with a smile on his face.
As time goes by.
Night falls.
It was a busy day for other lords, but it was a boring day for Su ye, mainly because there was nothing to do.
There are quite a few people chatting with him privately, but they are all live broadcast links.
Damn it, sex is the primary productive force. There are movie guys and movie girls everywhere. Su ye went to look at it with a critical mind, but it was free of charge.
The main thing is to open his eyes. After all, there are some things that Su ye has never seen before, such as tauren and lolita, trolls, tentacle monsters, meat armor and so on.
This was an eye-opener for Su Ye. He knew that the lord played tricks before, but he didn't expect it to be so fancy.
In the Fallen Heaven Temple, Su ye planned to deal with it here tonight. As for the Lord's Mansion, forget about the dilapidated wooden house, it was better to sleep on the grass outside.
Just when Su ye was about to consider taking a rest, a scent of fragrant wind came, and Su ye felt like he had entered a gentle embrace.
"Lord God Emperor, it's late at night and it's time for you to rest. It's also time for me to reward you." Lilith's soft and charming voice sounded.
Su ye looked at Lilith's eyes full of spring water. She was so delicate and charming that she seemed to be able to melt everything.
.........The dividing line cannot be written.....
Su ye spent the whole night dreaming.
